div.head: Abt 75.1[a]
div.ab: [For a widow] of the second [rank], 20 shillings.
For violation of the mund of a widow of the second class, 20 shillings;
that over one of the second class, with 20 shillings; over one of the third class, with 12 shillings; over one of the fourth, with six shillings.
[das] über die [an Range] zweite mit 20 Schll.,
[that] over the second [in rank] with 20 shillings,
div.note: Whitelock translates Abt 75.1 as one clause, which the sheet divides into rows 75.1[a], 75.1[b], 75.1[c]; her translation of the whole is given here, in the first row.

note.note: One footnote serves four places on p. 7: Abt 67.1, 70, 73 and 75.1.

note.seg: Diese Mundsumme kommt sonst nicht vor, während die nächste die des Adels laut o. 13f. darstellt; nur drei Mundsummen (und, wenn die Königsfamilie als Ein Stand gilt, nur drei Stände) scheidet das Kentische Recht sonst. Dürfte man XXV emendieren, so wäre das Verhältnis glatter 8 : 4 : (abgerundet) 2 : 1

This sum for mund does not occur elsewhere, whereas the next is that of the nobility, as shown above 13f.; otherwise Kentish law distinguishes only three sums for mund (and, if the royal family counts as a single rank, only three ranks). If XXV could be emended, the ratio would be a smoother 8 : 4 : (rounded) 2 : 1
